notes.title: 2184 - Parkour Prototype Showcase
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I'm excited to share our latest development progress for 2184 - a first look at our parkour movement system. This prototype demonstrates the core mechanics we're developing using Unreal Engine 5's motion matching capabilities.

While this is still an early build, it represents an important milestone in our development process. The movement system is being carefully crafted to deliver an engaging parkour experience that feels both responsive and natural.
